params.name: id

params.description: Search by record number, document number, title, customer name, email, device serial, registration, make and model

params.description: If templates or regular workorders should be returned. By default returns both

params.description: Record root entity (workorder, raji)

params.description: Record types to return. If undefined, defaults to 'workorder'

params.description: Record title. Uses case insensitive partial matching

params.name: groupIds
params.description: Record Group ID-s that must match

params.name: groupIdNil
params.description: Group ID field should be filled or empty

params.name: parentIds
params.description: Record Parent ID-s that must match

params.name: parentIdNil
params.description: Parent ID field should be filled or empty

params.name: childrenOfIds
params.description: Record ID-s for which child objects must be retrieved recursively

params.name: parentsOfIds
params.description: Record ID-s for which parent objects must be retrieved recursively

params.name: priorities
params.description: Record priorities that must match

params.name: warehouseId
params.description: Warehouse ids

params.name: customerId
params.description: Customer ids

params.name: contactId
params.description: Contact ids

params.name: deviceId
params.description: Device ids

params.name: state
params.description: Record state codes (draft, confirmed, checked_in, checked_out, in_progress, blocked, done, cancelled)

params.name: tranState
params.description: Record transactional state codes (preparation, estimated, prepaid, invoiced, paid)

params.name: taskSchedState
params.description: Record task scheduled state codes (some_scheduled, nothing_scheduled)

params.name: productStockState
params.description: Record row product stock state codes (parts_available, parts_not_ordered, need_po_finalization, awaiting_parts)

params.name: createdById
params.description: ID-s of employees who created the record

params.name: createdAtStart
params.description: Search for workorders created after the specified time (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ or UNIX timestamp)

params.name: createdAtEnd
params.description: Search for workorders created before the specified time (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ or UNIX timestamp)

params.name: updatedById
params.description: ID-s of employees who updated the record

params.name: receivedById
params.description: ID-s of employees who marked the linked device as received

params.name: receivedAtStart
params.description: Device received time range lower bound (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ or UNIX timestamp)

params.name: receivedAtEnd
params.description: Device received time range upper bound (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ or UNIX timestamp)

params.name: isReceived
params.description: Received or not received records

params.name: returnedById
params.description: ID-s of employees who marked the linked device as returned

params.name: returnedAtStart
params.description: Device returned time range lower bound (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ or UNIX timestamp)

params.name: returnedAtEnd
params.description: Device returned time range upper bound (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ or UNIX timestamp)

params.name: isReturned
params.description: Returned or not returned records

params.name: isConfirmed
params.description: Confirmed or not confirmed records

params.name: isCancelled
params.description: Cancelled or not cancelled records

params.name: hasDocPrepay
params.description: Search for workorders with linked prepayment sales documents

params.name: hasDocOffer
params.description: Search for workorders with linked offer sales documents

params.name: hasDocInvoice
params.description: Search for workorders with linked invoice sales documents

params.name: hasDocCredit
params.description: Search for workorders with linked credit documents

params.name: isFullyPaid
params.description: Search for workorders which have been paid in full

params.name: labelType
params.description: Label type

params.name: label
params.description: Labels under the specified labelType that must match

params.name: withTotalCount
params.description: If total matching record count should be return in response header

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Result page size

params.name: pageNr
params.description: Result page number

params.name: sort
params.description: Sorting order.
